```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(DESeq2)

```


```{r functions}

make_idents_counts <- function(
    ds,
    idents_choose="seurat_clusters",
    assay_="RNA",
    min_cell_num=200,
    keep=NULL,
    perc_expressed=10){
        slot_ <- "counts"
        Idents(ds) <- idents_choose
        group_names <- unique(Idents(ds))
        if (!is.null(keep)) {group_names <- keep
          
        }
        reads <- slot(ds, "assays")[[assay_]] %>% slot(slot_)
        #get rid of false genes / . in there name
        reads <- reads[rownames(reads) %>% str_subset(pattern = "[.]",negate = T),]
        #cut out genes with less then perc_expressed percent of cells that eypress the gene
        i_cells <- WhichCells(seurat_monocytes, idents = keep)
        
        reads_group <- reads[,i_cells]
        
        reads <- reads[(((reads_group > 1) %>% rowSums())> (length(i_cells)/100*perc_expressed)),]
        print(paste0(as.character(nrow(reads))," genes kept"))
        sum_counts_ds <- tibble(.rows =  nrow(reads))
        #z=1
        for (i in seq_along(group_names)) {
          print(i)
          #print(colnames(sum_counts_ds))
          print(group_names[i])
          i_cells <- WhichCells(object =ds,idents = group_names[i])
          if (length(i_cells)<min_cell_num) {
            sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%
            add_column(dings=0)
          colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i] <- paste0(as.character(group_names[i]),"_smaller" , as.character(min_cell_num))

          next}
          #i_cells <- WhichCells(object =ds,idents = "hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes_C19-CB-0003")
          reads_group <- reads[,i_cells] %>%  sparse_Sums(rowSums=T)
          
          sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%
            add_column(dings=reads_group)
          colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i] <- as.character(group_names[i])
          #print(as.character(colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i]))
          
        }
        
        sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%  mutate(gene=rownames(reads)) %>% relocate(gene)
        return(sum_counts_ds)
}

```

# count number of cells donor-celltype severe and mild
```{r}
n_tbl <- tibble(cluster=seurat_monocytes$cluster_clean, 
               donor=seurat_monocytes$donor, 
               experiment=seurat_monocytes$experiment,
               sex=seurat_monocytes$sex,
               condition=seurat_monocytes$group_per_sample) %>%
  group_by(cluster,donor,experiment,sex, condition) %>% 
  summarise(n=n()) %>%  mutate(keep=paste0(cluster,"__",
                     donor,"__",
                     experiment,"__",
                     sex
                     )) %>% 
  filter( condition %in% c("mild","severe"#,"control"
                                                 ),
          cluster %in% c("hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes","hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes" )) %>% 
  ungroup()



n_tbl %>%mutate(keep=fct_reorder(keep,n)) %>% ggplot(aes(keep,n))+geom_col(aes(fill=condition)) +theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

n_tbl %>% arrange(n)
```

# make full design matrix
```{r}
design_x <-colnames(expression_matrix)%>% 
  tibble(dings=.) %>% 
  separate(col= dings,into = c("cell_type","donor","experiment","sex"),sep = "__") %>%
  mutate_all(as_factor)

#add cellnumber as covariate
design_x <- design_x %>% mutate(cell_type_donor_experiment=paste0(cell_type, "_", donor, "_", experiment)) %>% inner_join(
  keep_tbl %>%
    mutate(cell_type_donor_experiment=paste0(cluster, "_", donor, "_", experiment)) %>%
             select(cell_type_donor_experiment,n))
#change order
reihenfolge <- paste0(design_x$cell_type,"__", design_x$donor, "__",design_x$experiment, "__",design_x$sex )
expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[,reihenfolge]

design_x
```


# apply DeSeq2 model with reduced design, because donor is linear comb of experiment
```{r}
# clusters <- unique(design_x$cell_type)
# clusters <- c("hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes", "hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes")

design_cluster <- design_x %>% select(cell_type, -donor,experiment,sex,n)
print(design_cluster)
res<- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(expression_matrix,
                            colData=design_cluster,
                            design= ~ 
                              experiment+
                              #donor+ #not full rank
                              n+
                              sex +
                              cell_type) %>% DESeq()

resultsNames(res)
```


```{r}
vsd <- vst(res, blind=FALSE)
plotPCA(object=vsd, intgroup=c("experiment", "sex", "cell_type"))
plotPCA(object=vsd, intgroup=c("experiment"))
plotPCA(object=vsd, intgroup=c( "sex"))
plotPCA(object=vsd, intgroup=c("cell_type"))
```

Data is only full rank by one sample
